name: planning
title: CO primary and secondary cost planning
description: CO primary and secondary cost planning. COSP/COSS also contain actuals: approve the plan value types and versions explicitly. Preserve period blocks, periods 01–16, fiscal-year variant, controlling/object/transaction currencies and debit-credit semantics. Resolve cost objects and accounts first. Target ACDOCP planning is not a field-for-field copy of these totals; choose a supported plan import and map period/currency types.
